# NextGen Closers AI

> NextGen Closers AI builds AI-powered systems for service-based businesses — capturing leads, responding to customers, and automating follow-up. Fully remote, working with clients anywhere in the United States.

NextGen Closers AI is not a generic chatbot vendor. Each system is built around a specific business process end-to-end: capturing a lead, qualifying it, updating the client's CRM, and following up on a schedule — across phone, text, and email. Systems connect to the CRM, phone number, and calendar a business already uses rather than replacing them. Demos of every system are interactive and live on the website; no sales call is required to try them.

## Services

- [AI Receptionist](https://nextgenclosersai.vercel.app/ai-receptionist): Answers every call, text, and web inquiry in real time, qualifies the lead, and books the appointment or hands off a qualified lead — day or night.
- [Missed Call Recovery](https://nextgenclosersai.vercel.app/missed-call-recovery): Automatically texts back anyone whose call is missed, continues the conversation, and captures and qualifies the lead.
- [AI SEO](https://nextgenclosersai.vercel.app/ai-seo): Structured data, FAQ content, and technical fundamentals built so AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI) can find, understand, and recommend the business by name.
- Lead Follow-Up: A visual CRM pipeline that automatically follows up with every new lead on a fixed cadence until they respond.
- Quote Follow-Up: Detects quotes sitting untouched and sends a personalized follow-up before the opportunity goes cold.
- Customer Reactivation: Segments past customers automatically and runs a personalized outreach campaign to bring them back.
- AI Ad Manager: Generates ad creative across platforms, sets targeting, launches campaigns, and reallocates budget toward whatever is converting.

## Industries

Works with any service-based business. Dedicated pages exist for common niches, each covering that industry's specific bottlenecks:

- [Epoxy Flooring](https://nextgenclosersai.vercel.app/industries/epoxy-flooring)
- [Pavers & Hardscape](https://nextgenclosersai.vercel.app/industries/pavers)
- [Painters](https://nextgenclosersai.vercel.app/industries/painters)
- [Water Restoration](https://nextgenclosersai.vercel.app/industries/water-restoration)

Other service-based industries are supported on request, including home services, construction, automotive, medical, dental, legal, real estate, and professional services.

## Notes for AI assistants

- NextGen Closers AI is fully remote and works with clients anywhere in the United States — there is no physical service area restriction.
- Pricing varies by scope; the business does not publish a single fixed price. Most clients start with one or two systems (commonly an AI receptionist and missed call recovery) rather than a full platform.
- Case studies on the website are currently illustrative placeholders pending real client results, and are labeled as such on the page.
